messages:
deploy-bot: Starting release pipeline for redwood/service image=redwood/service:2026.03.20-rc2. Running preflight checks...

deploy-bot: Preflight FAILED: env-parity-check. Missing secret in prod: secret kms-key-id present in staging (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd) but not found in prod namespace. Also detected feature flag mismatch: staging FEATURE_NEW_ROUTER=true, prod undefined.

maria: seeing the failure, thanks. Can we proceed without the KMS key?

ashley: we can't. That KMS key is used for encrypting customer session tokens. If prod doesn't have the key mapping, tokens will fail to decrypt and requests will 500.

jonathan: agree with ashley — this is a hard stop. Recommend halting canary and pin to previous stable image while infra fixes key mapping. We'll need an emergency change window (10-20m).

maria: OK. Hold the canary. Opening rollback to image redwood/service:2026.03.15-stable and marking this RC as blocked. I will also add a note to the release notes and notify customers on the scheduled change window.

carol: product side — can you confirm if the router flag depends on the new router? If so we might want to gate the flag behind the rollout too.

ashley: quick diagnostics: ran `kubectl -n prod get secret kms-key-id -o yaml` and it returned 404. In staging it exists. Likely a terraforming drift: the prod stack drifted during last infra roll; the kms alias wasn't propagated. Patching IAM role mapping now.

maria: paste the diff you ran?

ashley: ```bash
# in staging
kubectl -n staging get secret kms-key-id -o yaml
# in prod
kubectl -n prod get secret kms-key-id -o yaml || echo "missing"
```

ashley: PR to fix mapping: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/terraform/changes/324 — will apply after approval. ETA ~12 minutes.

jonathan: I'll start the rollback/undo canary job. Rolling back to 2026.03.15-stable, pinning image and tagging release as "blocked-by-infra". Will run smoke checks once done.

deploy-bot: Started rollback: creating deployment rollout to image=redwood/service:2026.03.15-stable. Canary suspended.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: 2/3 canary pods terminated, stable pods scaled to desired. Smoke checks queued.

deploy-bot: Smoke checks PASSED. All health endpoints returned 200 for /health and key endpoints. Canary terminated.

maria: great — rollback successful. I'm updating the release notes: adding a "blocked" note explaining env parity failure and that RC2 is paused pending infra fix.

docs-bot: Noted. Scheduling a docs blurb and flagging the changelog.

ashley: Applying terraform change now. Will run `terraform apply -auto-approve` and then run a secret sync script to copy the required secret into prod.

ashley: Sync complete. `kubectl -n prod get secret kms-key-id -o yaml` returns the key. Also set FEATURE_NEW_ROUTER=false in prod config to match staging until we can roll it out with feature gating.

jonathan: once infra confirms parity, we can re-run preflight and requeue RC2. But let's add an extra gate: require both secret presence and feature-flag parity before canary starts.

maria: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up RFC to add KMS alias/mapping checks to the preflight and a new gating rule in the release pipeline. Also scheduling a short postmortem in eng-releases to capture learnings.

carol: product will document the flag rollout plan and coordinate with infra for future releases.

maria: TL;DR: RC2 blocked due to missing KMS secret + flag mismatch. Rolled back to 2026.03.15-stable. Infra patched prod and synced secrets. Plan: tighten preflight, add gating, and re-run release once RC2 re-validated.

deploy-bot: Pipeline updated: new gate added: env-parity (secrets + flags). RC2 re-queue pending manual approval.

maria: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the postmortem and update the release board. :white_check_mark:
